aircraftReference.name: Seeschwalbe

crew.notes: Pilot, and an observer who works the wireless.

features: 1 x fixed forward 7.92 mm + 1 x flexible aft 7.92 mm machine gun, 1,500 rounds
needs no aerodrome: catapult, fjord, estuary or lee shore
aircraftReference.notes: At as_of this is the navy's ONLY search type: 613 km reach, NO RADAR, and one raider in commission to fly it from. The reconnaissance gap is real at the start date and is not closed until 1940. Frame section 6.3 rounds the reach to 615 km; the catalog's own figure is ferry 1,840 / 3 = 613, and the catalog owns specifications.
